title: Sparkcards: contextual recommendation cards for Optimize onboarding and quantization UI
creator: Aisha Carter
description: Design and produce a compact set of onboarding assets (called 'Sparkcards') that introduce Optimize toolkit recommendations inside the product first-run flow. Each Sparkcard is a single-line recommendation + supportive micro-visual that surface batching, KV cache, and quantization suggestions tailored to the user's initial workload profile. Goal: reduce time-to-first-optimize action and increase opt-in to suggested profile by 30% in the first session. Deliverables: 6 Sparkcard variants (3 batching/cache combos, 2 quant profiles, 1 fallback explanation), hi-fi screenshots for product release notes, and a short explainer GIF for the docs quickstart.
updates: 2026-02-28 - Kickoff: aligned with PM (Jaya Mehta) on success metrics; target release optimize-2026.04. Agreed scope: in-product cards + docs GIF. Blockers: final model profiling data from ENG-22158.
2026-03-03 - Early lo-fi sketches completed; explored three visual metaphors: chip+queue, speedometer, and stacked tiles. Shared Figma file with PM and Eng for initial alignment.
2026-03-05 - Feedback from Engineering: prefer compact single-line copy to avoid pushing down main onboarding CTA. Action: reduce copy to 1 sentence and add hover tooltip for details.

2026-03-07 - Design critique: selected 'stacked tiles' visual (represents cache + batch) with subtle motion to indicate throughput. Decided quant cards use an annotated toggle showing precision vs cost tradeoff.

2026-03-09 - Created hi-fi mocks for 6 variants and exported 1x/2x screenshots. Uploaded to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link/Sparkcards-2026-03. Added notes to each frame about variant trigger rules.
2026-03-10 - PM review (Jaya): requested stronger CTA phrasing for the card that nudges to 'Apply recommended profile' and suggested A/B copy test. Added two alternate CTAs for A/B.
2026-03-11 - Accessibility pass: increased contrast on micro-visual strokes and ensured card hit target meets 44px guideline. Noted in comments for handoff.

2026-03-12 - Engineering handoff meeting: agreed asset sizes, animation budget (150ms fade + 200ms slide), and how to expose tooltip text via i18n keys. ENG-22640 will implement frontend with feature flag 'sparkcards_v1'. Next: create final PNGs and GIF for docs, and write microcopy file for localization.
Next steps: finalize copy A/B variants, export all assets at required densities, record 600ms explainer GIF, and add screenshots to release notes checklist. Final review scheduled 2026-03-18.
attachments: Github PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/7891 (frontend integration for sparkcards, draft)
ux_acceptance_criteria: Sparkcards appear in first-run Optimize flow when profiling data indicates >10% latency variance or >15% token cost over baseline
Each card includes a single-line recommendation, an iconographic micro-visual, and a primary CTA (Apply recommended profile)
Hover/tap opens a tooltip with 2-3 sentence rationale and a link to the Optimize docs GIF
Assets exported at 2x and 3x PNG, and a 600px wide explainer GIF (loopable, under 1.2s)
Accessibility: text contrast >= 4.5:1 and tappable area >= 44px
Feature gated behind 'sparkcards_v1' flag and content keys exposed for i18n
